reason: The intended detector question is whether a condition identifies the violated rule in the correct file, not whether it reproduces HomeCheck's report-line convention.
denominator_reason: The 38 manual examples collapse to 30 unique file-rule targets when line is removed. Repeated instances of one rule in one file cannot be distinguished by a line-free prediction and therefore cannot be counted as separate detection units.
next_direction: Regenerate the joint E4b summary and reconciliation using file-rule detection only.
